integrity.proof_basis: Exact exhaustive signed-permutation vertex determinants with a cubic Bernstein-coefficient nonnegativity certificate over complete real parameter ranges, plus algebraic full-body volume and sharpness witnesses.
integrity.publication_priority_claim: Comparison-based only; absolute historical priority not asserted.

scientific_limitations: Only dimension three and the concentric cube–octahedron intersection family are treated.
Multiplicity counts classify vertex-supported maximizers, not necessarily all nonvertex equality tetrahedra.
The exact-polynomial certificate is independently reproducible but has not received an independent audit.
Bibliographic originality remains subject to undiscovered equivalents in earlier literature.
title: Sharp tetrahedral occupancy of cube–octahedron intersection balls
